name: Bulgan Province (Mongolia)
description: Green field charged in the centre with a golden wheat wreath enclosing the name БУЛГАН, a ship's wheel at its base and three coloured drops at its crown.

features.role: wheat wreath with БУЛГАН, ship's wheel and three drops

history: Bulgan replaced its earlier blue flag with this green design around 2022; FOTW documents the change from photographs of official use.
